blocks.text: In his classic barong Tagalog, Paulo Avelino personally received his Outstanding Asian Star trophy at the Seoul International Drama Awards 2026 in Seoul, South Korea, on Thursday, Oct. 8. Avelino was recognized for his performance in the ABS-CBN romance-mystery series “The Alibi,” alongside six other Asian stars selected through a global fan-voting process. The award recognizes performers from different Asian countries and regions. ABS-CBN PR took to social media to post a video of Avelino’s acceptance speech at the ceremony held at KBS Hall in Yeouido, where he thanked the fans who voted for him and the people he worked with […]...
